mostWorthwhile.text: Putting ATP to work was most worthwhile because it connected the energy supply to protein building and the membrane pump in one picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Putting the prepared ribosome into the cell was clear but predictable: the goal and locator both gave away the placement.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the same ATP supply supported both building proteins and moving particles toward the more crowded side of the membrane.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely arbitrary. The pump’s exact job was not fully clear when I fitted it, but its picture and the goal gave that placement a purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because seeing separate cell parts come together and do different jobs made me curious about what comes next.
